comments.text: I thank Dr. Mike a lot for teaching his viewers much about medical stuff and all the symptoms and all of that. I’ve been watching his videos since years and as a teenager I have always been interested in medicine. Today I had a conversation with my Mom bc my dad suddenly had neck pain and a headache… he took some pills to numb the pain but nothing worked and he felt more sick throughout the night. In the morning my Grandma came in and told him that they needed to go to the emergency room right now.. My parents have always played down their pains and I couldn’t hold back any longer and intervened. It was very obvious to me that he wasn’t having a normal „headache“.. his speech was slow and he wasn’t really there.. ofc it was in the morning but still quite unusual for him. I did the FAST test and everything seemed okay except his speech ofc. So I argued back and forth with him and my mom. In the end the only reasonable worst case scenario in my head was: stroke or  a brain hemorrhage. I told them about my concerns and how quick we’d have to act. Luckily my grandma was on my side and took him to the ER. They clarified that it’s not a stroke but thought it could be a corneal inflammation. After some hours we got the info that he was transported to a bigger hospital bc they have found out he had a brain hemorrhage. Luckily he was still conscious and could speak and comprehend things. Just some hours ago they preformed surgery on him. We don’t know anything further.. but all I can say is: Thank you Dr. Mike for teaching us all the right things so we can help or atleast motivate people to take their pains seriously. Especially as a Teenager I want to show my parents to take their health seriously and become aware of things more. Through your knowledge I was able to share that knowledge to my parents or other people and warn them. Thank you!❤(im very sorry if my English is bad. English is my second language)
